title: Started: one shared song
old_caption: How it started: one wired earbud each, a very short wire, zero personal space on a park bench. How it's going: a playlist called 'us' and they still never skip track one. Got a track one?

title: Started: a terrible pun, total silence
old_caption: How it started: Gemini on a rooftop says 'I'm Sirius-ly into you' to total silence and one tumbleweed. How it's going: a full pun volley, and Capricorn lands the callback.

title: My friend dared me to answer the talk card honestly
old_caption: Scorpio was all sunglasses and mystery, until a friend behind a potted plant held up DARE: BE HONEST. The truth: tiny knitted hats for houseplants. Eleven hats later, here we are. What's your secret hobby?

title: We were both twenty minutes early
old_caption: Virgo showed up twenty minutes early to look chill. So did Gemini. They both hid, both fake-checked phones, and walked around the block twice, passing each other. Early or late person?

title: We argued about pizza toppings for an hour
old_caption: First date: Taurus said absolutely not to pineapple, Aries said absolutely yes, and the waiter closed up around them. Now it's half and half every Friday. Pineapple: yes or no?

title: They laughed at my worst joke
old_caption: First date on a hilltop. Sag asks why the star went to school. 'To get brighter.' Total silence, the moon winced, a tumbleweed passed. Then Capricorn snorted. What's your worst joke?

title: We matched on the blind card I almost skipped
old_caption: Card seven said TALKS TO PIGEONS, and Capricorn nearly skipped it. Six months later they have a pigeon, and the pigeon has a spreadsheet. Ever almost skipped someone great?

title: Tell me you're a Sagittarius without telling me
old_caption: Packed bag by the door. Keys jingling for a spontaneous road trip, right now. The trip: the corner store, one block, with you. Best trip ever. Sag, how close is this?

title: Tell me you're a Scorpio without telling me
old_caption: Sunglasses indoors because the lamp is a lot. Remembers your favorite snack from a Tuesday in week one. And the intense stare? Just listening, very hard. Scorpios, how accurate is this?

title: Tell me you're a Taurus without telling me
old_caption: Five blankets minimum. The usual, every time (extra fries counts as trying something new). Then it handed over the last fry, the big one. Tell me you're a Taurus without telling me.
